mapper.sql: select p.worker_profile_id, p.user_id, u.nick_name, u.phonenumber, u.sex, u.avatar, p.id_card_no, p.worker_type, p.intro, p.service_star, p.service_count, p.employment_status, p.work_status, p.org_id, p.status, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark from hm_worker_profile p left join sys_user u on p.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select service_item_id from hm_worker_service_rel where worker_id = #{workerId}
select area_id from hm_worker_area_rel where worker_id = #{workerId}
where p.status = '0' order by p.service_star desc, p.worker_profile_id desc limit 6
